title: Theo and the Uniform
author: Paloma Coldharbour
blurb: Mara Sterling, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
